The Sacred Poets of the Nineteenth Century

He gave thee, He took thee, and He will restore thee, / And Death has no sting, for the Saviour has died!

—
Thou art gone to the Grave
 (ll. 15–16).

Reginald

Heber

The Sacred Poets of the Nineteenth Century

Edited by Alfred H. Miles

Nearly 500 selections by over 100 authors–each with a critical biography–illustrate a flowering of devotional Christian verse by the likes of Newman, Keble, Milman, Heber, Lynch and Grosart.
